svg.title: Rule tablet: The gods' rules
svg.desc: The gods' tablet: eight worn registers of ochre clay, and a first rule whose wedges are sharp and whose clay is paler than the rest, pressed long after the others.
svg.text: We do not ride on the backs of the gods.
We do not ride on the backs of the gods.
No one walks before a god.
No one walks before a god.
No hand touches a god.
No hand touches a god.
The sand of the deep belongs to the gods; no
The sand of the deep belongs to the gods; no
one takes from it.
one takes from it.
What the gods leave behind is holy and may not
What the gods leave behind is holy and may not
be trodden.
be trodden.
The holy is not carried away.
The holy is not carried away.
A son of the clan returns by the third moon, or
A son of the clan returns by the third moon, or
is named lost.
is named lost.
No one sleeps where the gods have not slept.
No one sleeps where the gods have not slept.
